info.title: AI Dial-Tone experimental self-hosted Asterisk BYOT connector
info.description: LOCAL LOOPBACK ONLY. Live origination disabled by default. Tested with simulated ARI and UDP, NOT real Asterisk. Operator mandates do not constitute verified human identity. No public hosted API. WebSocket media requires one-time ticket in first message, DT01 PCM frames. The server is not suitable for production or public exposure.

servers.description: Experimental loopback-only self-hosted connector (not publicly hosted)

Operator revokes mandate and stops active call
Agent consumes one-use mandate; does NOT dial until WS start

post.summary: Agent receives 20-second single-use media admission ticket

200.description: Use in first WebSocket message, never URL

post.summary: Independent operator stop; ARI release check is not carrier proof

get.summary: WebSocket: admit ticket then send start; DT01 PCM binary frames and limited control JSON
get.description: Ticket is supplied in the FIRST WebSocket text message {"type":"admit","ticket":"..."}; then agent sends {"type":"start"}. No call begins before admission/start. Outgoing 16 kHz signed PCM16LE 20 ms frames (DT01 + 4-byte sequence + 8-byte timestamp + 640 samples). The connector converts them to RTP/L16. Incoming RTP is forwarded as DT01 after exact source validation. media.bridged does not mean media ready; media.ready follows validated first RTP. No public Internet access or carrier release verification.

get.summary: Operator-only, non-dialling read-only ARI endpoint observation; NOT a route guarantee
get.description: Authenticated operator bearer is required. Observes only the connector-configured fixed PJSIP endpoint through ARI. No call, OPTIONS verification, carrier test or billing can occur. The response always has network_call_authorised=false, with not_proven explicitly describing absent evidence.

200.description: Endpoint observed; online does not mean a call will complete

401.description: Agent/unauthorised credential cannot probe the endpoint

503.description: ARI unavailable or endpoint observation failed; no dialling
